name: markdown-document
body: A markdown source file scanned as a document: its headings are sections (symbols) nested by heading level, and its links are references (Uses edges) to other documents/sections. The document is the unit the markdown frontend discovers and emits. A section is a Struct because only Struct can contain Struct under the graph schema, so heading-level nesting is representable; a Function cannot contain and a File cannot contain a Module. Realised by the markdown frontend.
